title: 176 Red Cedar Way Vacation Rental
meta_description: 176 Red Cedar Way is a 5.00 bedroom, 5.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description Nestled just steps from Camp WaterColor’s green space, this beautiful five-bedroom, five-and-a-half-bath home offers an inviting blend of luxury, relaxation, and family comfort. With elegant interiors, multiple porches, and thoughtful details throughout, 176 Red Cedar Way is the perfect retreat for families looking to enjoy WaterColor’s beauty and charm.Property Highlights Exclusive Access to the WaterColor Beach Club and Community Pools with Up to 12 Passes Included 6 Adult Bikes Included in Rental Parking for 2 Vehicles Natural Gas Grill Exterior Shower Located in the Heart of WaterColor’s Camp District Large Back Deck with Waterfall and Fireplace 1-Minute Bike Ride to Camp WaterColor Pool 4-Minute Bike Ride to Seaside 5-Minute Bike Ride to WaterColor Beach Club and Beach Access Experience the Home Situated directly across from the tranquil Camp WaterColor green space, this thoughtfully designed home combines comfort and sophistication with a layout perfect for gathering. The open living area features an inviting fireplace, a 66-inch flat-screen Apple TV, and surround sound that extends throughout the home and onto the outdoor deck. The fully equipped gourmet kitchen includes Thermador and GE Monogram appliances, a bar with seating for five, and a dining table that seats twelve, ideal for family meals or entertaining. Just off the kitchen, the children’s playroom offers a flat-screen TV, chalkboard door, and plenty of toys for younger guests to enjoy. For added convenience, there are two laundry rooms, one on each floor. The first-floor primary suite features a king bed, private bath with soaking tub, walk-in shower, dual vanities, and direct access to the back deck. Upstairs, a cozy book nook at the top of the stairs provides the perfect spot to unwind with a favorite book, while a private office offers an ideal workspace for guests who need to stay connected during their stay. The second floor includes two queen guest bedrooms, each with private bathrooms featuring shower/tub combinations. A second primary suite features a king bed, a luxurious private bath with soaking tub and dual-head shower, and access to a serene back porch with a daybed swing. The large bunk room is a dream come true for kids and teens, featuring two sets of twin bunks, a queen sleeper sofa, and a large Apple TV with plenty of space for games and relaxation. Outdoor living is equally impressive, with multiple porches and a large back deck featuring a wood-burning fireplace, waterfall, and comfortable seating. The front porch swing and upper-level daybed offer peaceful spots for quiet moments, while the Weber gas grill and outdoor dining space make it easy to enjoy alfresco meals surrounded by nature. Every detail of this home has been designed to provide an exceptional experience, making 176 Red Cedar Way a true WaterColor gem.Sleeping Arrangements First Floor: Primary Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Soaking Tub and Walk-In Shower Half Bathroom Washer and Dryer Second Floor: Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combination Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combination Primary Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Soaking Tub and Walk-In Shower Guest Bedroom: Two Twin Bunk Beds (Sleeps 4) + Queen Sleeper Sofa (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combination Washer and Dryer Life in WaterColor From 176 Red Cedar Way, you’ll enjoy effortless access to the best of WaterColor, lush trails, beautiful parks, Camp WaterColor, and the Beach Club. Whether you’re gathering on the back deck, relaxing by the fire, or biking to Seaside, this home promises the perfect blend of luxury and laid-back coastal living. Guests may rent an electric cart exclusively through The Electric Cart Company. Please note that WaterColor allows only one electric cart per home, and rentals are available on a first-come, first-served basis. Advance reservations are strongly recommended, especially during peak seasons.
